newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise, Fla., chooses Hough for annexation bonds.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise, Fla., chooses Hough for annexation bonds.

text.p: City of Sunrise has chosen William R. Hough & Co to underwrite a $15.7 million bond issue to finance annexation incentives for the west Broward County neighborhood of Bonaventure.
Sunrise City Commission authorized the deal at a meeting Tuesday night.
The bond issue is contingent on an April 1 election in which Bonaventure's 10,000 residents will vote whether to join the city of Sunrise or the city of Weston.
The bonds would finance the purchase by Sunrise of 21 acres in the upscale Bonaventure suburb, including the Bonaventure Saddle Club and Racquet Club.

The agreement calls for the purchase of the property by July 1. Sunrise and Weston have both lobbied intensively to annex the unincorporated Bonaventure neighborhood, which has a property tax base of $285 million.
